# EffeTune documentation snapshot (Japanese)

- Commit: 6791afdfc6f4e6c913b9f48c8189a44e29a09bde
- Why this commit: it is the `external/effetune` submodule of EffeTune Mixwright v0.13.0,
  release commit 230e5ad8ae8f6e866bc923419fbc198ee559c856, the VST3 build bundled with mImageViewer.
